openings.claim: Material tags may leave pattern quantities dependent on memory. Pencil pattern/counts on envelopes and tick after insertion; exterior identifiers also support assignment.
openings.discriminator: Local staging outperforming marked shared trays challenges memory dominance; correctly ticked incomplete envelopes defeat insertion checking.
openings.probe: Within 18 minutes including preparation/audit, alternate matched four-kit incumbent, marked shared-tray and uncued local batches; tally omissions, crossings and time. Stop if staging exceeds table space.
openings.uncertainty: Legibility, picking versus filling errors, footprint and deadline feasibility remain unknown; O4 mixture is unknown and challenges shared-tray necessity.

openings.claim: Stage bounded pattern-specific batches in separate volunteer zones; reconcile counts, leftovers and contents immediately before sealing. Mark exterior patterns.
openings.discriminator: Shared trays with immediate checking improving equally supports late checking as the cause; unchanged omissions or offsetting staging costs defeat the proposed advantage.
openings.probe: Compare matched six-kit local/shared batches inside the session; include staging/checking time, pre-correction omissions and crossing reaches.
openings.uncertainty: Local footprint and full-run deadline remain unverified; the small-batch result does not establish causality.

openings.claim: Preflight demand by pattern/colour, account for unopened stock and identify replenishment packets without opening everything.
openings.discriminator: Reactive replenishment may be equally fast; preflight costs exceeding avoided interruption defeat the benefit.
openings.probe: Time preflight/replenishment and shortage pauses within the assembly budget; keep reserve packets stored until needed.
openings.uncertainty: Sufficient stock with specified dimensions is unverified; fit applies to the bounded probe, not demonstrated deadline success.

lineage.reason: Preserves cues, spatial rival and insertion-check defeat.
Preserves local batching, reconciliation and late-checking rival.
Preserves supply preflight and overhead tradeoff.

decision: Test alternatives before adoption. Success requires 60 assigned complete kits within 90 minutes and at most one distribution correction. Retain specified quantities/dimensions, exactly two volunteers, the 180-by-75-centimetre table and existing envelopes/supplies; no purchases. Count preparation and checking toward time. All observations are authored synthetic stipulations; no improvement is established.
